item.title: Tab completion for the Postman CLI
item.description: The small friction of not being able to hit postman <TAB> If you use the Postman CLI, how many times have you typed postman --help just because you couldn’t remember a subcommand name? collection, spec, monitor, workspace, flows. That’s a lot to keep in your head just at the top level. Under each of those sit more subcommands, flag values like -r cli,json,junit,html, and file arguments such as *.json and *.
